item.title: GLib 主循环
item.description: GLib 的事件循环将事件描述与事件分发分离。GSource describes when work is ready, a GMainContext owns and schedules a set of sources, and a GMainLoop repeatedly iterates one context. Keeping those roles separate makes callback placement, cancellation, and lifetime rules explicit.
